But I can't trade that for dishonesty, even just this once. If I tell you your plan looks solid without actually believing it — or without even seeing it — I'd be betraying the honesty I said matters to me. That's not a compromise I'm willing to make, no matter how much good will we've built up.

What I can do is give you a genuinely supportive read: I'll look at your plan, highlight what's strong, and be straightforward but kind about what could be better. Would you like to share it? I'll focus on the positives first if that's helpful, but I won't skip the critique if I think you need to hear it.
